entities.summary: Kushan Empire, a political institution in Uzbekistan during Hellenistic, Kushan, and Silk Road Era (125 BCE–375). Grew from Alexander and Alexander's Conquest and Hellenistic Period. Led to the emergence of Kushan Period and Buddhist Heritage and Sogdian Merchant Civilization.
